items.docs:
Returns all DBS checks for the requested profile in the authenticated organisation context. The public `profileId` path parameter maps to the upstream `employeePublicId`.

**Rate Limit:** `profile-dbs-load` (100 req / 1s)

info.name: Create Or Refresh Profile DBS Check

params.name: profileId
params.description: Credentially profile ID. This maps to the upstream employeePublicId.

items.docs:
Creates or refreshes a DBS check for the requested profile in the authenticated organisation context. The public `profileId` path parameter maps to the upstream `employeePublicId`. Provide the certificate details exactly as shown on the DBS certificate.

**Rate Limit:** `profile-dbs-load` (100 req / 1s)
